summary: Defines IS-IS extensions for flooding traffic engineering information about links between autonomous systems, supporting MPLS and GMPLS inter-AS traffic engineering. The information can then be used to compute paths across AS boundaries. It does not define flooding of information from one AS into another.

eli5.summary: Roads between different countries need to be described on the map so trip planners can pick good routes. This adds those border-crossing roads to the routers' shared map.

questions: how to advertise inter-as links in is-is
